title: Bounded, recoverable lifecycle for Bahia's PostgreSQL Nostr event store
problem: The append-only nostr_events audit/outbox relation reached 19 GB and approximately 12 million live rows in about six weeks, with no archival or pruning lifecycle.
intended_behavior: Bahia exports bounded non-pending batches to immutable digest-addressed artifacts, requires a protected object receipt before pruning the exact claimed rows, restores idempotently, builds large indexes online, and exposes storage/backlog metrics.
non_goals: Rewriting the existing 19 GB table during application startup
Deleting pending or failed outbound events
Treating local filesystem durability as protected archival
